## Purpose

Describe the user or compiler problem and the smallest coherent change.

## Stochastic and thermodynamic contract

State any conditional kernel, energy, variable type, parameter-sharing, scheduling,
lowering, approximation, fallback, or target implication. Write `Not applicable` only for
changes that cannot affect these semantics.

## Evidence

- [ ] Ruff formatting and linting pass.
- [ ] Strict Pyright passes.
- [ ] Pytest passes.
- [ ] Package distributions build.
- [ ] Semantic changes include mathematical documentation and scientific contract tests.
- [ ] No unsupported performance, hardware, or energy claim was added.
- [ ] No credential, private data, or generated experiment output is included.
